Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. Then, if your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand, return 1 of your opponent's level 6 or higher Digimon to its owner's hand.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an effect adds cards to your opponent's hand, if you have a Tamer in play, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to its owner's hand.
